# Claude Code Docs

> Official documentation for Claude Code.

## Getting started

### Overview

#### Getting started

- [Overview](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/overview.md): Claude Code is an agentic coding tool that reads your codebase.
- [Quickstart](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/quickstart.md): Install Claude Code in your terminal and make your first change.

#### Core concepts

- [How Claude Code works](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/how-claude-code-works.md): Understand the agentic loop and built-in tools.

##### Claude Code in the cloud

- [Use Claude Code in the cloud](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/claude-code-on-the-web.md): Run sessions in the cloud from your browser.

## Build with Claude Code

### Plugins

#### Plugins

- [Create plugins](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/create.md): Build a plugin with skills, hooks, and MCP servers.
- [Plugins reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins-reference.md): Manifest schema and component reference for plugins.
